scope.implementation_ownership: Main agent and builders; this sidecar owns only the screening document and this provenance file.

date_policy: UTC timestamps where available. consulted_on is an access date, not a publication date. Null publication dates and versions are unverified, not inferred.
verification: Primary pages inspected with web; GitHub API timestamps and release-pinned source hashes checked by read-only in-memory network requests. The versioned arXiv appendix was streamed from its source archive.

concepts.title: Hardware-aware commuting phase-parity compilation
concepts.relationship: Direct paper seed; weighted topology/reuse objective is a proposed extension.

concepts.title: Compact graph-constrained linear reversible synthesis
concepts.relationship: Direct representation/synthesis seed; concealed witnesses and caps are proposed benchmark design.

concepts.title: Adaptive cross-resonance calibration
concepts.relationship: Extension of the paper's calibration assumption, not a calibration experiment demonstrated in the paper; adaptive finite-shot SPAM-aware design is proposed.

concepts.title: Minimal diagnostic suites for unsafe rewrites
Budgeted selection of additional native-gate calibrations

screening_constraints.A: The requested 30% gain against a meaningful frozen portfolio is an unvalidated target; baseline headroom must be screened.
screening_constraints.C: One concealed native witness must satisfy both gate and depth caps. This certifies feasibility, not optimality or hardness.

requirements: Trusted preparation/measurement anchors and a fixed frame/sign convention.
An identifiability audit for the allowed Hamiltonian and bounded SPAM nuisance family.
Held-out observable prediction or anchored process scoring rather than unidentifiable raw coefficients.

rejected_standalone_tasks: Ordinary Gaussian elimination or generous all-to-all/line synthesis
Standalone GraySynth or independent-term parity compilation
Fixed noiseless Ramsey or sinusoid fitting
Copying a known bug reproducer or solving one supplied matrix pair
Modulo-angle folding without interacting compilation passes
Known-parameter simulation or a gate-count crossover formula

sources.title: Quantum computing with Qiskit
sources.supports: Linear/phase representations, retargetable compilation, dynamic Ising comparison, and an assumed calibration of partial-ZX gates.
sources.limitation: The paper does not establish the proposed benchmarks' hardness or the adaptive calibration protocol in E. HTML rendering truncates mid-paper.

sources.title: Appendices A and B of Quantum computing with Qiskit
sections: Appendix A: Suppressing errors in dynamic circuits
Appendix B: ISA for IBM Quantum Heron Processors
sources.supports: Conditional crosstalk compensation, measurement/feedforward latency, ancilla reset and timing/control-flow constraints.
sources.limitation: Supplementary detail is embedded in the paper; no separate supplement is claimed. Hardware timings and ISA descriptions are historical to this version.

sources.title: Qiskit synthesis API
sources.supports: Existing GraySynth, PMH and KMS algorithms that standalone tasks must go beyond.
sources.limitation: Page publication date and exact documentation patch build were not verified.

sources.title: GraySynth implementation
sources.supports: Concrete existing parity-network synthesis implementation; not a tested baseline in this sidecar.

sources.title: CrossResonanceHamiltonian characterization
sources.supports: A CR Hamiltonian with I/Z on control and X/Y/Z on target, duration scans, control-state preparations and target measurement bases.
sources.limitation: Predates the paper. Does not establish the proposed adaptive SPAM-aware task or its identifiability; E requires additional trusted anchors.

sources.title: PadDynamicalDecoupling implementation
sources.supports: DD insertion in idle periods, logical-action preservation, spacing and pulse-alignment constraints.

sources.title: Simulation of kicked Ising Hamiltonian with dynamic circuits
sources.supports: Explicitly cites the seed paper and implements ancilla ZZ interactions, feedforward, reset and stretch-based DD.
sources.limitation: Rolling page; publication date and commit version were not verified. Not a frozen executable baseline.

sources.title: Fix CommutationChecker for controlled rotation gates
sources.supports: A concrete corrected commutation failure motivating independent semantic counterexamples.
sources.limitation: Historical fixed defect; no claim that current Qiskit still exhibits it.

sources.title: FoldRzzGate does not work properly with XXPlusYYGate
sources.supports: Reported interaction between XXPlusYY synthesis and RZZ angle legalization.
sources.limitation: Reporter-provided evidence; not reproduced here. Closure does not identify a particular fix or establish present behavior.

sources.title: Improve Sabre heuristic defaults
sources.supports: Routing heuristic scaling changes make baseline version and search-budget pinning essential.
sources.limitation: Its reported benchmark effects do not validate A's proposed 30% threshold.
